about:
Elite Metal Fabricators, Inc. operates from Boyd, Texas, in the Dallas–Fort Worth metro area. The company has accumulated over 25 years of experience in metal fabrication, building a portfolio of more than 500 completed projects and partnerships with over 15 industry collaborators. Founded on a passion for craftsmanship, the business remains privately held, though specific ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides a full suite of fabrication services, including custom fabrication, architectural metalwork, precision machining, structural design, specialized coatings, industrial welding, equipment installation, and on‑site fabrication. It also offers pre‑construction planning such as field measuring and advanced fabrication planning, along with site management and civil‑engineering support. The facility handles projects in stainless steel and a range of exotic alloys, though exact equipment lists and capacity figures are not published.

Clients span healthcare, education, civic, commercial, and infrastructure sectors. Concrete examples include hospitals, universities, community buildings, zoos, international airports, shopping malls, and various commercial‑construction and infrastructure projects. The company emphasizes collaboration from concept through installation, serving both private businesses and public institutions.

Leadership cites transparency, open communication, and integrity as core differentiators, aiming to craft excellence in every structure while creating possibilities for clients and communities. The team highlights its willingness to tackle one‑of‑a‑kind installations and intricate design challenges that demand unique metal‑fabrication solutions.
